purpose: Secondary geometric clarity subset; never changes labels, class-balanced sampling, train/test splits or the 1200-row primary set. These heuristic margins are not independent label-quality validation.
averages: All body/range means use the ten sessions preceding the candle being assessed. Hammer near allowance uses the five ranges preceding the previous candle. Trend is the five-session close move ending before the pattern starts, compared with the ten-range mean ending at that same pre-pattern candle.

none.definition: Clear only if none of these deliberately expanded near-pattern geometries match. Trend is ignored; Hammer placement and Shooting Star gap are ignored, so a rule-negative but visually hammer/star-like final candle is not called a clear negative.

interpretation: Clear means comfortably within the frozen numerical geometry rules. It is an ex-ante heuristic for secondary analysis, not a verified human clarity label, error rate, trading signal, or guarantee of pixel-level recognizability. None uses conservative expanded geometry exclusions instead of being automatically clear. No JEV result informed these thresholds.
